items: 【Precision Mastery ±1Ft】Next-generation UWB positioning, engineered over three years by a U.S. team using advanced chips and AI algorithms. ±1 ft accuracy across a 160 ft radius eliminates false alarms, giving your dog safe freedom and you complete peace of mind. Ideal for yards of any size, indoor or outdoor adventures, and most breeds from small to large

【All-in-One Professional Control】A sleek, intuitive system combining wireless containment, remote training, and indoor barrier management. Effortlessly switch between Fence Mode (3–160 ft), Training Mode (0–1000 ft), and Indoor Barrier Mode (3–30 ft). No wires, no digging, no device swapping—one compact system adapts seamlessly to every real-life dog ownership scenario

【Smart TFT Real-Time Awareness】Stay informed at a glance with the full-color TFT display on your remote. Monitor distance, active mode, correction level, battery status, and boundary alerts in real time. Whether at home, in the yard, or exploring outdoors, you maintain full visibility and professional-level control over your dog’s activity, behavior, and safety

【Rapid Charging & Weather-Resilient Design】Type-C fast charging powers the collar in 3 hours and the remote in 3.5 hours. Enjoy consistent daily use: remote up to 48 hours, collar up to 24 hours per charge. The IPX6 waterproof collar is engineered to withstand rain, splashes, and outdoor conditions, giving your pet safe and reliable protection in any environment

【Multi-Dog Support & Worry-Free Warranty】Supports up to 3 dogs, 10–120 lb, neck sizes 8–25 inches. No app or subscription needed—straightforward, professional-grade control. Backed by a 1-year warranty and responsive customer support, delivering enduring safety, convenience, and confidence for your entire household. Perfect for growing families, multi-dog homes, and professional trainers
